'''Lumiere of Dalaran''' is a human located at the [[Jousting Grounds]] in [[Northwind]]. One of the participants in the Northwind jousting tournament representing the [[Dalaran (kingdom)|magocracy of Dalaran]], he faces off against [[Sir Barnabas of Strom]].
